items.title: VantageScore CreditGauge™ October 2026: Consumer Credit Demand Increases, but Subprime Borrowers Face Growing Repayment Pressure
items.why: Rising demand alongside subprime strain argues for tighter monitoring of credit-driven spend in premium portfolios.
